# 131. Palindrome Partitioning

## Solution 1

```python
# DFS
class Solution(object):
    def partition(self, s):
        """
        :type s: str
        :rtype: List[List[str]]
        """
        self.ans = []
        self.dfs(s, [])
        return self.ans

    def dfs(self, s, cur_ans):
        if s == "":
            self.ans.append(cur_ans[:])
            return
        for i in range(len(s)):
            cur_str = s[:i + 1]
            if cur_str == cur_str[::-1]:
                self.dfs(s[i + 1:], cur_ans + [cur_str])
```
